messages:
Priya Sharma: Pulled together a short draft for the product launch blog + two hero CTAs. Link: https://docs.google.com/fake-link. Need a quick pass on claim tone, CTA routing (webinar vs direct demo), and how we surface the benchmark details. Hoping to lock copy by 9:30am PT tomorrow.

Miguel Torres: Reading now. Quick Q: should webinar be the primary funnel or are we privileging demo requests for enterprise? This changes CTA text.

Priya Sharma: Webinar is the primary top-of-funnel. But demo CTA should be prominent for accounts that meet intent signals. We'll run an A/B on hero to see which yields more SQLs.

Jess Lee: Routing proposal:
- Webinar CTA -> landing page + HubSpot form 'launch_webinar_2026' (seat cap 250)
- Demo CTA -> HubSpot 'request_demo_prod' -> DEMO_QUEUE_PRIORITY (include account_tier)
- If webinar full -> show 'watch the recording' and capture email for nurture.

Sam Patel: Legal flag: any specific numeric performance claims need supporting benchmark links and test conditions. Also prefer two distinct CTAs so ops can route cleanly.

Uma K: Agree with Sam. Edit suggested: change hard claims like "50% cost savings" to "significantly lowers per-token cost in production workloads" and link to benchmark appendix with methodology. Then legal comfortable.

Priya Sharma: Updated hero to: "Significantly lowers per-token cost in production workloads" and added a short benchmark note + link to appendix. Updated doc.

Miguel Torres: UTM convention for analytics: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=prod_launch_2026, utm_content=heroA|heroB. For demo submissions include account_tier and lead_priority fields.

Jess Lee: HubSpot mapping confirmed: hs_campaign=prod_launch_2026, lead_source=website, internal_segment=webinar_registrant. Demo leads get tag 'sales_prioritize'. Ops will subscribe to DEMO_QUEUE_PRIORITY.

Priya Sharma: Great. I've integrated UTM and HS fields in the CTA table. Copy lock target remains 9:30am PT tomorrow. Any objections?

Sam Patel: No objections. :thumbsup:

Priya Sharma: Thanks all 1010 Will finalize and ping ops to prep routing and fallback landing for recordings.
